en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town nestled in a forested valley. A winding main street runs through densely packed houses with steep roofs; in the mid‑distance stands a large church-like building and another tall church tower rising above the trees. Hills covered with thick woodland surround the settlement. In the lower right corner, the caption "Tharandt." is printed.
